metadata.description: Claude Code plugins from the makers of Floe Market.

plugins.name: in-engine-promo-clips
plugins.description: Make short promo clips, trailers and comedy sketches out of a game's own engine: scripted acting, frame-by-frame renders with the game's sound, voices, synthesised effects, crash-in captions and an end card.

plugins.name: licence-check
plugins.description: Check that every package and asset a change brings in may ship the way your project ships and is credited: copyleft and non-commercial licences, fonts, emoji, sounds and music (with songs hiding in recordings), images, models, AI assets, people, brands and SDKs.
